_comment: Pinned dependencies bundled into the app. download-dependencies verifies every archive against sha256. An empty sha256 means the pin is not recorded yet: the script prints the digest it saw and fails, and the value is then recorded here.

dependencies.name: ffmpeg
dependencies.purpose: Video, audio and image conversion and media details (ffmpeg.exe, ffprobe.exe and their shared libraries)
